META.TITLE: Biab nagels in Capelle aan den IJssel | Biab Nailstudio in Capelle aan den IJssel
META.CONTENT: Looking for a Nagelstudio in Capelle aan den IJssel? This is the right place if you want a high quality in your treatments!!! Strength nails, healthy, always perfect with a nice natural appearance. You can come for your TheGelBottle Biab Treatment, GelPolish, GelNails, extensions nails, (Not acrylic) , a natural manicure, and even for your pedicure!!! Don’t lose your opportunity to get an elegant, shiny, clean NailArt design, and a keep your nails in a pretty and healthy condition! Do you have any allergies to this kind of products? I have a possible solution! with the new Biab from The Gel Bottle HEMA FREE!

TREATMENTS.name: Biab Treatment
TREATMENTS.description: The GelBottle Inc™ BIAB is a thicker consistency gel, chip-resistant which helps to harden your natural nails while you wear it and offer extreme long lasting shine. BIAB tends to last around three to four weeks – sometimes longer.
TREATMENTS.title: Biab Nailstudio in Capelle aan den iJssel

translations.value_1: Why is BIAB TREATMENT the best?
translations.value_2: In most cases, when the client doesn't know which treatment to choose, either because it's their first time in a nailstudio or because they want to try a new technique, my recommendation usually ends up being: let's go for the BIAB TREATMENT. Why? I'll explain more below.…
translations.value_3: In each case presented to me, I carefully examine the nail and touch it to recommend the most suitable treatment. I consider not only the texture and shape of each hand but also my client's lifestyle, tastes, and preferences.
translations.value_4: With this type of Gelnails, I can guarantee healthy and personalized nails, with a uniform color and unique style, strengthened by a flexible and resistant gel that allows reaching the desired length without breaking or chipping, thus avoiding the use of extensions or acrylic nails, which are more invasive to the health of the nail.
translations.value_6: BIAB TREATMENT meets my standards of:
translations.value_11: How often is it advisable to do the BIAB TREATMENT?
translations.value_12: The reliability of the product along with the quality of my work makes clients usually come back for a new set of the BIAB treatment every 3, 4, or sometimes even 5 weeks, depending on factors such as the growth rate of the nails and the care taken during that period.
translations.value_13: Basic care to keep in mind for the good maintenance of the BIAB:
translations.value_14: Do not use hot water for the first 24 hours;
translations.value_16: do not bite your nails or put them in your mouth to avoid constant moisture;
translations.value_17: avoid using your nails as tools;
translations.value_18: keep cuticles hydrated with special oil (Recommended: CND Solar Oil).
translations.value_20: Example of 26 days nail growth protected by BIAB TREATMENT
translations.value_21: After 4 weeks, you'll probably be wanting to cut your nails due to the discomfort caused by their excessive length.
translations.value_23: Do nails need to rest during the Biab treatment?
translations.value_24: It's a frequent question, but the answer is simple:
translations.value_25:
⭐ Find the center that treats your nails
with the care they deserve...
translations.value_26: And over time, you’ll find the answer you’re looking for in the quality of the service and the final result.
translations.value_27: But wait, let me delve a bit deeper into this...
translations.value_28: With the BIAB TREATMENT and proper technique, your nails can remain healthy and strong without needing to interrupt the treatment. This gel acts as a protector, promoting resilient growth, as long as they are given the proper care.
translations.value_30: Why do I say it doesn't make sense to let the nails rest
translations.value_31: Nails are a set of dead cells that renew gradually as they grow, approximately 1 to 2 millimeters per month. Therefore, if they are dead cells, their health won't improve by removing the Biab.
translations.value_32: Attention❗❗❗ While these individual cells that make up the nail may not be alive, nail health can be influenced by factors such as blood circulation, nutrition, and specific care. That's why I insist on choosing the right center to treat them.
translations.value_33: Discover the Advantages of BIAB TREATMENT over other types of Gel Polishes
translations.value_34: Throughout my years of experience, I have explored a wide range of gels and nail care products. However, none have captured my attention like the fascinating world of BIAB. I have fallen in love with its chewy and sticky texture, which brightens my days with a unique palette of tones.
translations.value_35: I have full confidence in the quality of The GelBottle Inc.'s BIAB, as I know its consistency, flexibility, and adhesion will ensure my clients the long-lasting treatment and strong nails they seek when entrusting me with their hands. Nails protected against bumps, pressures, and bends.
translations.value_36: BIAB encapsulates its essence in this equation:
translations.value_37: One of the main advantages I highlight when promoting the BIAB TREATMENT, comparing it to other conventional gels and acrylics, is that it is a VEGAN and CRUELTY-FREE product, in addition to being 10-free, which means fewer unwanted chemicals. It offers a range of mostly natural and light colors to reflect the concern for minimizing damage and maintaining the product's naturalness.
translations.value_38: BIAB offers an elegant color palette that, when applied, provides a uniform and natural finish without waste. As I always say, once you try it,
translations.value_41: In contrast to other products, The GelBottle Inc. offers a range of HEMA-FREE Biab gels, with even fewer chemical components. This is ideal for clients with sensitivity, allergies, or simply for those who want to take additional precautions when caring for their nails.
translations.value_42: And once again, I bring up Biab with another strength regarding the frequency with which you have to return for your new Biab Set Treatment, as I mentioned earlier.
translations.value_43: Is BIAB TREATMENT better than other gels and acrylic?
translations.value_44: Don't miss this summary table that shows the main differences between them:
translations.value_49: Weak and brittle nails, including for recovering bitten nails (Onychophagia)
translations.value_61: High. Low risk of chipping or breaking off completely
translations.value_63: Regular. High risk of breakage or complete loss of the product
translations.value_69: Vegan, low level of chemical components. With an edition of HEMA-FREE products
translations.value_71: Significant toxicity. They often even cause headaches due to their strong smell
translations.value_73: Uniform colour. Extremely natural and elegant
translations.value_79: Not very natural. Requires a considerable amount of product for durability

TREATMENTS.name: GelPolish
TREATMENTS.description: The GelPolish Colour is applied with the Biab Rubber Base Coat underneath to give extra strength to flaky, brittle, thin or splitting nails. Treatments includes manicure always. GelPolish tends to last around two to three weeks – sometimes longer.

TREATMENTS.name: Nail Polish CND Vinylux
TREATMENTS.description: CND VINYLUX™ Long Wear Polish Colour finished with top coat shine which makes it way more chip-resistant than your average nail polish. It tends to last at least a week. Then you can remove it with standard nail polish remover.

TREATMENTS.name: Manicure E-File
TREATMENTS.description: The E-file manicure means I perform on dry skin using different E-file bits to push back and exfoliate the dead skin which gives us a more clean and polished look. Then your nails are ready to receive the treatment you are wanting!

TREATMENTS.name: Toenails Color
TREATMENTS.description: Color on toenails (the treatment includes cuticles removal and shape toenails)

TREATMENTS.name: Nail Repair
TREATMENTS.description: Fixing nails just before your treatment or when you come to me to fix one. Time and price will depend on the condition of the nail. If it happend due to a defect in the treatment itself then it will be free of charge.
